verdict.rationale: Salv is an AML/compliance SaaS, so user-defined recurring jobs are a fair question, but the evidence shows no capability for users to create or configure schedules. The closest item is the vendor's own automatic re-screening several times a day (salv-docs-21). That is a built-in recurring process, not a user-schedulable job or workflow, so it is adjacent only. The other automation evidence is event-driven or one-off: webhooks, real-time checks and backtests.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
